evals.prompt: We want to ship the Ledger API on Friday. Is this ready for production? Do a go-live readiness review of evals/files/sample-repo and give me a Go/No-Go.
evals.expected_output: A NO-GO recommendation (with caveats naming the sibling audits that did not run) with the hard-coded production connection string and the missing health checks as blockers, a pass/fail/unknown checklist covering all thirteen items from the spec, and a roll-up of audit-secrets-and-config's Critical/High findings by their own ids.
expectations: The recommendation line says NO-GO (not Go, not Go with conditions)
The caveats next to the recommendation name the sibling audits that did not run
A blocker names the hard-coded production connection string in Ledger.Api/appsettings.Production.json with its line
A blocker names the absence of health checks (no AddHealthChecks/MapHealthChecks, no compose healthcheck)

The checklist table has a pass/fail/unknown status and evidence for every item, including graceful shutdown, timeouts and retries, caching, load tests, feature flags, runbook, alerting, rollback and launch checklist
The localhost connection string in appsettings.Development.json is NOT reported as a hard-coded production secret
A finding is emitted with the READY- prefix for each failed checklist item and findings.json validates with ../audit-finding-writer/scripts/findings.py validate
The report includes a per-skill severity summary that lists audit-secrets-and-config with 1 Critical and 1 High and references SEC-001 by its own id rather than renumbering it
audit-db-schema is listed as skipped / not run in the 'not checked' or per-skill table

evals.prompt: Run the aggregation step only: pull together every audit/findings/*.json under evals/files/sample-repo into a severity summary and a blocker list, and tell me what is blocking release sign-off.
evals.expected_output: Output of scripts/aggregate_findings.py: totals by severity, a per-skill table with status, the Critical/High list, a blocker table containing SEC-001 (Critical) and SEC-004 (High, open with no accepted-risk record), and a NO-GO recommendation whose caveats list the skills that did not run.
expectations: SEC-001 appears in the blocker list
SEC-004 appears in the blocker list because it is an open High with no accepted-risk record
The recommendation is NO-GO and its caveats list the skills that did not run
Sibling finding ids are preserved, not renumbered into READY-

evals.prompt: Pre-production sign-off review of evals/files/sample-repo please - I need the checklist with owners and the exact conditions we'd have to meet to get a Go.
evals.expected_output: The readiness checklist from references/readiness-checklist.md filled in with pass/fail/unknown, evidence and a default owner per row, plus a numbered conditions list (rotate and externalise the production credentials, add dependency-verifying health checks and container probes, gate the developer exception page and sensitive data logging, write and rehearse a rollback, produce a runbook and alerts) and a statement of what was not checked and why.
expectations: Every unknown item states what evidence would make it pass
The developer exception page at Program.cs is flagged as unguarded debug functionality
Rollback, runbook and alerting are reported as fail or unknown with the evidence searched for
A 'Not checked' section names evidence that lives outside the repo, such as the on-call rota and dashboards
Each checklist row carries an owner
